title: The frontend names the intra-trade health certificate "ITAHC" and carries a fourteenth document type, "Health certificate", that DR1 does not offer.

finding.frontend: Fourteen document types are defined, and the label the trader reads in the Document type column of the added-documents table is taken straight from that list (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/view-model/rows.js:46-53). Two of the fourteen do not match DR1. ITAHC is labelled with the bare acronym, 'ITAHC', and there is an extra type, HEALTH_CERTIFICATE, labelled 'Health certificate' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:26-42); the enum behind both is fourteen codes long (src/server/app/services/document-types/stub.js:1-16). The captured row happens to be a veterinary health certificate, whose label matches DR1 exactly, so the divergence is not visible in this corpus's pictures.
finding.prototype: DR1's list is thirteen types and spells the certificate out in full — "Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)" — both in the select and in the Document type column of the saved table (app/views/upload-documents.html:116-129, fed by designReleaseDocumentTypeOptions at app/routes.js:9019-9022). It has no "Health certificate" type; that option exists in the prototype only in a testing variant of the list that DR1's journey never selects.
finding.difference: Relabel ITAHC as "Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)" and drop HEALTH_CERTIFICATE from the offered types, in both the English and Welsh copy files. The label change is visible today, wherever a derived ITAHC record is listed; dropping the extra type only becomes visible once the Document type select exists, so the two land together. Removing a code from the enum needs a check that no saved record already carries HEALTH_CERTIFICATE — nothing can produce one but a file named for it, and the derivation makes that possible today.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the frontend rendering "Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate (ITAHC)" in the Document type column for a record whose derived type is ITAHC.

relatedTo.why: the corrected list is what the new select must offer
